goal: Design a behaviorally comparable Hermes-like bioagent without copying its source, using a model-neutral iterative Chase bake. This is a DESIGN TEMPLATE, not a working clone.

target.description: Hermes-like tool-using agent with separately selected agent behaviors; pinned source and rights review are required before actual bake

anchors.statement: Pin target revision and record the externally observable capabilities required
anchors.test: Baker reviews reference revision and feature inventory

anchors.statement: Define measurable acceptance tests for each selected capability
anchors.test: Baker approves tests against pinned reference

anchors.statement: Verified body behavior remains useful in declared MIND-stasis conditions
anchors.test: Run accepted scenario battery for MIND active and inactive states, compare target behaviors
